units.en: Note that the Balance of Power may easily run to the right side upon war victories, making harder to push it to the left, so it is best not to trigger this mechanic until you are done with your conquest.

Adjust your industries as necessary, build only military factories and maybe infrastructures for now as you will get a lot of civilian factories very soon. Set some factories to build transport planes. Research paratroopers and military police immediately. Switch your occupation law to Local Police Force. Start your focuses with one of the three military branch focuses, basically you want all that leads to ⟦0⟧, ⟦1⟧, and ⟦2⟧ as you will only have a small window of opportunity to complete these focuses, though you can ignore ⟦3⟧ if you have no wish to play with the navy. Once you get enough military XP, get the Proper Heritage ⟦4⟧ and make the largest cavalry division template as possible for garrison, adding the MP once it finishes research then switching it for State Serves the Military once done.

Send absolutely everything at ⟦0⟧, you do not want them to become a government in exile. (They generally go exile after one complete 35-day focus period after they hit 35% surrender progress: e.g., if they hit 35% during the second focus period - in mid-to-late February or early March - you'll have until April 15th to capitulate them.) Restart the game if they do as this will cause whoever you are at war with to immediately join the ⟦1⟧. DO NOT take the ⟦2⟧ focus until you are done with the conquest below.

Once you are done with ⟦0⟧, you can start justifying on ⟦1⟧, switch your mountaineer to normal infantry template and train 7-8 paratrooper divisions as soon as you are done with paratrooper research. You can stop building transport planes once you get just over 50 of them and station them on one of the northern airfields. Once your justification is done, declare war on ⟦2⟧ immediately or you will risk a ⟦3⟧ guarantee. Send your paratroopers (one at a time) at Paris plus 6 or 7 other cities to capitulate ⟦4⟧ ASAP, avoid the border cities as these are usually guarded. This is not as easy as it sounds. You require 70% air superiority to paradrop, France starts the game with 452 fighter planes to your 300, and it is guaranteed by Belgium, which adds another 40, so you'll need to have half of your military factories building fighters and transports just to have 50 transports + air parity by the time you declare in early 1937. But openings do happen, even without sustained 70% (try assigning all your fighters to the same region and flipping them between North Italy and South France). Use Last Stand if your paratroopers are under attack after they land. Take everything that ⟦5⟧ has in the peace deal, and don't forget the navy.

Now start justifying on ⟦0⟧. In the meantime, send all the ships you have, including the ⟦1⟧ ships, to a port in Northern France and prepare for a naval invasion of the ⟦2⟧. Have an army group defend the Eastern border of ⟦3⟧ and ⟦4⟧ and 2 groups preparing to invade the ⟦5⟧. Ignore Africa for now. The ⟦6⟧ should guarantee ⟦7⟧ which will pull them into the war. Once the war has begun, you will want to take advantage of the 15 days justification, so you want to do just that and declare war on them immediately. The main targets apart from those you are already at war with are: ⟦8⟧, ⟦9⟧, ⟦10⟧, and ⟦11⟧. However, you might as well get as many as you can, ⟦12⟧ (for the achievement), ⟦13⟧, the ⟦14⟧, ⟦15⟧, ⟦16⟧, and ⟦17⟧ are good targets so might as well do it. While you do want ⟦18⟧, they are probably in a civil war and as with ⟦19⟧, you can get them via focus instead. Capture all of ⟦20⟧ mainland (except Northern Ireland) but do not capture London so you can take your time. Try finishing the focuses ⟦21⟧, ⟦22⟧, and ⟦23⟧ during this war as you will not get another chance until much later. Annex everything except for ⟦24⟧, just take their lands except those 3 provinces that will be claimed by the ⟦25⟧. Don't forget the Royal Navy. If you want to avoid war with ⟦26⟧, just leave out one province of ⟦27⟧ and the ⟦28⟧. Note: if you are going for ⟦29⟧, this is a good time to go after the ⟦30⟧; do it before the next step.

Now it is time to take the ⟦0⟧ focus, once it completes go to the Balance of Power and take all the decisions which push the power to the left (red). Keep going down the focus and complete ⟦1⟧. This allows you to hire the advisor which increase non-aligned popularity. Follow up with ⟦2⟧ focus. You can detour and get your 5th research slot as well as ⟦3⟧ and ⟦4⟧ focuses if you wish. Before you take the ⟦5⟧ focus, there are a couple of things you want. Take ⟦6⟧ and ⟦7⟧ focus just after it since you cannot take these focuses if you are no longer ⟦8⟧, you may also want to complete the ⟦9⟧ branch next as it unlocks a support company and some other bonuses which you will keep later on but since this increases ⟦10⟧ popularity, you might as well do these just before turning ⟦11⟧. Also you want to take the ⟦12⟧ branch until you reach ⟦13⟧ to get ⟦14⟧. One final wrinkle to be aware of is that ⟦15⟧ switches your ideology and that automatically cuts the hard-earned compliance in all your non-core territories, including Ethiopia, in half (but you get 10% back as a hidden focus reward), and it removes the "Vittorio Emanuele III, Emperor of Ethiopia" national idea, which substantially reduces compliance growth rate. Take ⟦16⟧ when you are done. Hire the advisor which increase political power gain if you wish.

Once ⟦0⟧ popularity is over 50% (you can make it faster by banning ⟦1⟧ and ⟦2⟧ as well as taking the Press Censorship and Anti-fascist Raids decisions), take the ⟦3⟧ focus then immediately take the 3 focuses after it starting with ⟦4⟧. Some will unlock a Balance of Power decision to push it to the left. Once ⟦5⟧ focus is complete, take ⟦6⟧ focus. Since you have taken the ⟦7⟧ focus, you should be able to hire Dino Grandi as advisor. Depend on how far to the left the balance of power have been pushed, this can possibly make the Pope take power. If not, just wait until the decisions are available again and try going down the focuses to get ⟦8⟧ in the meantime.

Keep going down the focus up to ⟦0⟧. You can get Spain via either ⟦1⟧ or ⟦2⟧ focus, the latter requires you to reduce their autonomy to annex them. Now you should be able to take the decision to form the ⟦3⟧. If you wish to continue playing and get another achievement (⟦4⟧), you can use the war goal you get from ⟦5⟧ to declare war on the ⟦6⟧ and join ⟦7⟧'s attack.
